name: Spacebring
description: Connect your Spacebring co-working space so the assistant can answer member FAQs and manage room bookings, events, visitors and support tickets.

list_locations.label: List Locations
list_locations.description: List the co-working locations your Spacebring account can access.

find_membership.label: Find Member
find_membership.description: Look up a member (by email) to resolve who you're helping.

get_membership.label: Get Membership
get_membership.description: Get a member's profile and credit balance by id.

list_resources.label: List Rooms & Desks
list_resources.description: List bookable meeting rooms, desks, offices and parking.

get_resource.label: Get Room/Desk
get_resource.description: Get details for one bookable resource, including its schedule.

list_bookings.label: List Bookings
list_bookings.description: Check room availability or list a member's reservations.

create_booking.label: Book a Room
create_booking.description: Reserve a meeting room or desk for a time slot.

get_booking.label: Get Booking
get_booking.description: Get the details of a single booking.

cancel_booking.label: Cancel Booking
cancel_booking.description: Cancel a reservation and free the slot.

list_guides.label: List Guides
list_guides.description: List house guides and FAQs (Wi‑Fi, rules, how-tos).

get_guide.label: Get Guide
get_guide.description: Read the full content of a guide, e.g. the Wi‑Fi article.

list_feed_posts.label: List Announcements
list_feed_posts.description: List community feed posts and announcements.

get_feed_post.label: Get Announcement
get_feed_post.description: Read a single community feed post.

get_event.label: Get Event
get_event.description: Get the details of a single event.

list_benefits.label: List Perks
list_benefits.description: List member perks and partner benefits.

get_benefit.label: Get Perk
get_benefit.description: Get a single perk and how to redeem it.

list_visits.label: List Guest Visits
list_visits.description: List guest visits, optionally for a specific host.

create_visit.label: Register Guest
create_visit.description: Register or invite a guest for a visit.

get_visit.label: Get Guest Visit
get_visit.description: Get a guest visit, including its access code.

create_support_ticket.label: Report a Problem
create_support_ticket.description: File a support ticket (broken AC, printer, Wi‑Fi, etc.).

get_support_ticket.label: Get Support Ticket
get_support_ticket.description: Get a support ticket and its status.

apiKeyId.label: API Key ID
apiKeyId.description: Spacebring API key ID (the username for Basic auth). Generate API credentials in Spacebring under Settings → Integrations → API.

apiKeySecret.label: API Key Secret
apiKeySecret.description: Spacebring API key secret (the password for Basic auth). Stored encrypted.

locationRef.label: Default Location ID
locationRef.description: UUID of the location this assistant serves. Used as the default for every tool. Find it with the List Locations tool or in your Spacebring dashboard URL.
